description.value:
This circuit-laced headband creates a backup of your genetic code each morning, providing insight not only into your own physical wellbeing but that of others. You gain a +2 item bonus to Medicine checks.

Activate—Reset Code 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You press a button on the back of the headband, partially resetting your physiology. You immediately regain @Damage[8d8[healing]] Hit Points. You can immediately attempt a flat check to recover from any persistent damage you're taking, as if assisted. You can also immediately attempt a new saving throw against any ongoing effects that have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Paralyzed] you or that have the disease or poison traits, taking the new result. A creature adjacent to you can also Activate the genetic backup, but its effects still apply to you.
